scenario.title: 跟行銷、工程、業務部門合作
scenario.context: 跨部門合作時，大家會一直說要「追蹤一下」「想辦法」「搞定」「把事情釐清」。這些全是片語動詞：follow up、figure out、work out、sort out、come up with。學會它們，會議筆記和 email 都會更道地。

lines.speaker: Tony
lines.en: So marketing needs the campaign visuals by the 15th. Does design have the bandwidth?
lines.zh: 所以行銷部 15 號前需要活動視覺。設計部有餘力嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: It's tight, but we'll figure it out. Can you send the copy by Monday?
lines.zh: 很緊，但我們會想辦法。你週一前可以給文案嗎？

lines.speaker: Tony
lines.en: We're still working out the key message, but I'll follow up by Friday.
lines.zh: 我們還在研究主要訊息，但週五前會跟你確認。

lines.speaker: Ken
lines.en: From the engineering side, we'll need the assets in specific sizes. I'll send over a list.
lines.zh: 工程這邊需要特定尺寸的素材，我會傳一份清單。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Great. I don't want to step on anyone's toes, but who has final approval?
lines.zh: 好。我不想越權，但誰有最終核准權？

lines.speaker: Tony
lines.en: Good question. Let's sort that out now so we don't pass the buck later.
lines.zh: 好問題。現在就講清楚，免得之後互相推卸責任。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Tony signs off on copy, Minz on visuals. Any issues, come to me.
lines.zh: 文案由 Tony 簽核，視覺由 Minz。有問題來找我。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Hi Tony, just following up on the copy. Any updates?
lines.zh: Tony 你好，追蹤一下文案，有更新嗎？

lines.speaker: Tony
lines.en: Sorry! We came up with three options but couldn't decide.
lines.zh: 抱歉！我們想出三個選項但決定不了。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Could you send all three? We can mock them up and see which works best visually.
lines.zh: 三個都可以傳給我嗎？我們先做成模擬稿，看哪個視覺上效果最好。

lines.speaker: Tony
lines.en: That's a great idea. I'm on it.

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Thanks. We'll turn it around in a day.

lines.speaker: Tony
lines.en: Amazing. You guys are the best.

patterns.en: Let's sort out the roles first.
I'll loop you in when it's ready.
Let's set up a quick call.
We'll turn it around in a day.

chinglish.right: I'll follow up on this. / I'll keep track of this.
chinglish.why: 「跟進這個案子」直翻 follow this case 很怪。追蹤進度說 follow up on。

chinglish.wrong: We need to think a way.
chinglish.right: We need to figure out a way. / We need to come up with a solution.
chinglish.why: 「想辦法」直翻 think a way 不對。用 figure out / come up with。

chinglish.wrong: This is not my business, please ask marketing.
chinglish.right: That's more on marketing's side. Tony would know.
chinglish.why: not my business 聽起來像「不關我的事」，很冷漠。

chinglish.wrong: Please give me the copy until Monday.
chinglish.right: Could you send the copy by Monday?
chinglish.why: 截止期限用 by，until 是「一直到」。

grammar.title: 片語動詞 follow up / figure out / work out
grammar.oneLiner: 職場最常用的片語動詞，意思多半不能從字面猜，要整組記。
whenToUse: follow up (on)：追蹤、後續確認。I'll follow up on the invoice.
figure out：想出來、搞懂。We need to figure out the budget.
work out：解決、成功；計算。It worked out in the end. / Let's work out the costs.
sort out：處理好、整理清楚（第 12 單元學過）。
come up with：想出（點子）。She came up with a great name.
turn around：完成並交回。Can you turn this around by tomorrow?
follow up 的名詞：a follow-up（後續追蹤信）；不可拆開的：come up with, follow up on。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文用單一動詞：「追蹤」「想辦法」「解決」「想出」。英文職場卻偏好片語動詞，因為聽起來比較口語、親切。台灣人常用比較正式的單字（investigate、solve、propose）來避開片語動詞，結果 email 讀起來很生硬。另外，片語動詞的受詞位置和介系詞也常出錯。

examples.correct: I'll follow up with the client tomorrow.
examples.note: follow up with + 人，follow up on + 事。

examples.correct: I can't figure out why the file won't open.
examples.incorrect: I can't figure why the file won't open.

examples.note: work out 不及物 = 最後會順利。

examples.correct: She came up with the idea for the campaign.
examples.note: come up with 三個字都要。

quiz.question: I'll ___ with you next week about the contract.
Who came ___ with this brilliant idea?
The launch was stressful, but everything ___ in the end.
Could you send the copy ___ Friday? (截止期限)

slang.usage: 原意是網路頻寬，職場借用來說「有沒有空處理」。I don't have the bandwidth.

risk.note: 典型的科技業行話，有人覺得做作。聽得懂最重要。

examples.en: I don't have the bandwidth to take on another project.
examples.zh: 我沒有餘力再接一個案子。

examples.en: Does your team have the bandwidth for this?
examples.zh: 你們團隊有空處理這個嗎？

slang.usage: I don't want to step on anyone's toes. = 我不想越權／冒犯別人。

risk.note: 常用來表示尊重對方的職責。

examples.en: I don't want to step on your toes, but can I make a suggestion?
examples.zh: 我不想越權，但我可以給個建議嗎？

examples.en: He stepped on a lot of toes when he joined.
examples.zh: 他剛加入時得罪了很多人。

slang.usage: I'm on it. = 我正在處理 / 我馬上做。

risk.note: 簡潔有力，同事間很常用。

examples.en: A: Can someone fix the typo? B: On it!
examples.zh: A：有人可以改錯字嗎？ B：我來！

examples.en: Don't worry about the invoice. I'm on it.

slang.usage: 把責任推給別人。The buck stops here. = 責任由我承擔。

risk.note: 指控別人 passing the buck 很重，說的時候要小心。

examples.en: Stop passing the buck and take responsibility.
examples.zh: 別再推卸責任，負起責任吧。

examples.en: Every department kept passing the buck.
examples.zh: 每個部門都在互踢皮球。

review.question: Which is the softest request?
options: It'd be great if you could send it today.
review.explanation: 複習第 54 單元：It'd be great if…

review.question: The deadline is tight. ___, we need extra help. (因此)
Which is strongest?
options: I was involved in the launch.
I launched the campaign in three markets.
review.explanation: 複習第 51 單元：強動詞。

review.question: ___ with engineering, we finished two days early.
review.explanation: 複習第 47 單元：分詞構句。

review.question: If marketing ___ the copy by Monday, we'll finish on time.
review.explanation: 複習第 39 單元：type 1 if 子句用現在式。
